propositions: code_health metric is language-coupled and non-portable; other metrics (module_size_distribution, cap_change_events) hardcode Python/rebar-specific paths and fabricate zeros on absent paths instead of reporting Unavailable
rebar core should adopt a configurable polyglot analyzer stack (scc/lizard/jscpd) accessible only via optional [metrics] extra, leaving core dependency-free
missing or unconfigured analyzer for a project language must emit honest Unavailable with clear reason, never fabricate zeros or leak raw exceptions
module-size cap policy should be decoupled from hardcoded governance artifacts and re-expressed as optional per-project configuration over generic LOC signal
analyzer interface must support per-project tool selection and language thresholds, with deterministic outputs (no network, no LLM) across Python and at least one non-Python client
